mapper.select: SELECT SIGN_ON_YN FROM TB_FEP_INST WHERE INST_CD = #{instCd}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_FEP_INST WHERE INST_CD = #{instCd})

SELECT I.INST_CD, I.INST_NM, I.SIGN_ON_YN, I.LAST_ECHO_DT, I.LAST_ECHO_OK, I.UPD_DT, I.UPD_EMP_ID, COUNT(L.LOG_ID) AS CNT, COUNT(L.LOG_ID) FILTER (WHERE L.RESULT_CD = 'ERROR') AS ERR, COUNT(L.LOG_ID) FILTER (WHERE L.RESULT_CD = 'TIMEOUT') AS TMO, COUNT(L.LOG_ID) FILTER (WHERE L.RESULT_CD = 'BLOCKED') AS BLK, ROUND(AVG(L.ELAPSED_MS) FILTER (WHERE L.RESULT_CD IN ('OK', 'ERROR'))) AS AVG_MS FROM TB_FEP_INST I LEFT JOIN TB_FEP_MSG_LOG L ON L.INST_CD = I.INST_CD AND L.REQ_DT >= #{from} AND L.REQ_DT < #{to} GROUP BY I.INST_CD, I.INST_NM, I.SIGN_ON_YN, I.LAST_ECHO_DT, I.LAST_ECHO_OK, I.UPD_DT, I.UPD_EMP_ID ORDER BY I.INST_CD
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FEP_INST SET SIGN_ON_YN = #{on}, UPD_DT = #{now}, UPD_EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE INST_CD = #{instCd}
UPDATE TB_FEP_INST SET LAST_ECHO_DT = #{now}, LAST_ECHO_OK = #{ok} WHERE INST_CD = #{instCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FEP_MSG_LOG (INST_CD, TX_TYPE, TRACE_NO, REQ_DT, ELAPSED_MS, RESULT_CD, RESPONSE_CD, REQ_BYTES, RES_BYTES, REQ_HASH, ERROR_MSG) VALUES (#{instCd}, #{txType}, #{traceNo}, #{reqDt}, #{elapsedMs}, #{resultCd}, #{responseCd}, #{reqBytes}, #{resBytes}, #{reqHash}, #{errorMsg})
